claims.summary: Characteristic zero. For the degree-two pair space V_a of n roots, separated or with one double root (confluent rows f_ik, f_Ak, T(1+AT)^(-5/2)(1+a_kT)^(-3/2), (1+AT)^(-3)), the binom(n,2)-square Taylor determinant at T=0 is a polynomial on the stratum that is not identically zero: the Taylor matrix at t of V_a is an invertible row transform of the Taylor matrix at 0 of V_u, u_c=c/(1+ct), and the Wronskian of V_a is not identically zero.
claims.assessment: Working proof by Moebius translation, using t+X=t(1+u_AX)+(1-tu_A)X for the derivative rows; exact control at one random point for n=3..7.
claims.rationale: Supplies the integral-block genericity of the half-class reduction for confluent clusters, and any pattern of the same shape.

claims.summary: Characteristic zero, M>=3. In the cluster degeneration (eps b,1,-1) of the one-double-root pair space with the double root inside the generic cluster, the Newton polygon of the cleared Wronskian numerator has on slopes (0,1) exactly the M-2 binomial edges of slopes j/M and length 2M: exactly 2M(M-2) simple neck Weierstrass points for small eps, none at scales eps^(-alpha), alpha in ((M-2)/M,1).
claims.assessment: Working proof: the half-class reduction lemma extended to confluent clusters (block structure, valuations, integral leading coefficient by the translation lemma) plus the confluent neck hull theorem.
claims.rationale: Makes the confluent neck results statements about the whole pair space; the remaining part of confluent simplicity is the binary face for a confluent cluster (unchecked) and the cluster-scale bubble with two double roots.

relationships: Extends the reduction to confluent clusters.
Confluent rows and Taylor expansions at t.
